scope: clear only an old unreferenced VFS private rootfs; all live image cache-id/container mount-id/init-id references checked before deletion; no tool image or registered container removed
command:
orphan_id=62a2b5fd074e09fc8abeaafde6ede14c59f1bdaa9583af19b731e20a42cc72d9
refs=$(find /layerdb -type f \( -name cache-id -o -name mount-id -o -name init-id \) -exec grep -Fxq "$orphan_id" {} \; -print)
if test -n "$refs"; then exit 42; fi
test -d /owned-orphan
test ! -L /owned-orphan
du -sk /owned-orphan
find /owned-orphan -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec rm -rf -- {} +
du -sk /owned-orphan
